summary: Live Oak Bancshares, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose that its Board of Directors declared a cash dividend of $0.03 per common share and $0.52344 per depositary share of its 8.375% Fixed Rate Series A Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, payable September 15, 2026 to shareholders of record September 1, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or strategic event is involved. The filing is purely administrative and does not trigger special-situations analysis.
